dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 小南，这家泰国饭馆的菜怎么样？
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, zhè jiā Tàiguó fànguǎn de cài zěnmeyàng?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 跟曼谷的一样好吃！你一定要尝尝冬阴功汤。
dialogue.reading: Gēn Màngǔ de yīyàng hǎochī! Nǐ yīdìng yào chángchang dōngyīngōng tāng.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 冬阴功汤？我吃过，很辣吧？
dialogue.reading: Dōngyīngōng tāng? Wǒ chī guo, hěn là ba?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Yòu suān yòu là, fēicháng xiāng.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 那你吃芒果糯米饭吧，又甜又香！
dialogue.reading: Nà nǐ chī mángguǒ nuòmǐfàn ba, yòu tián yòu xiāng!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Hǎo! Wǒmen hái yào liǎng ge yēzi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 椰子又甜又好喝，我在曼谷常常喝！
dialogue.reading: Yēzi yòu tián yòu hǎohē, wǒ zài Màngǔ chángcháng hē!
